whatIsAnswer: CodeSpectra is a skills-assessment platform for hiring teams and colleges. It runs proctored, auto-scored tests for software, QA, CAD and aptitude roles and ranks every candidate on one shortlist, so reviewers only look at the strongest.
whatIsPoint1: Coding, multiple-choice, written and CAD questions in one timed test
whatIsPoint2: Proctoring flags (tab switches, face match, copy-paste) sit next to each score
whatIsPoint3: Free practice, mock tests and verifiable certificates for candidates
reportTitle: Every screening ends in a ranked report
reportLead: Switch roles to see the same ranking applied to design and QA hiring. Shortlisted candidates are marked, and any integrity flag sits next to the score.
step1Body: Pick the role and experience band. CodeSpectra assembles a question mix weighted to that level, and you can edit any question before it goes out.
step2Body: Email invites to your applicant list and send reminders to anyone who hasn’t started. Each invite opens a timed, proctored session.
step3Body: Fullscreen lock, tab-switch detection, webcam face matching and copy-paste blocking run during the test. Every event lands on the candidate’s report.
step4Body: Candidates arrive ranked by difficulty-weighted points. Check flags, read answers, then release results or export them as CSV.
platformLead: Build the test, proctor it, score it and rank it, for engineers, designers, testers and graduates alike.
candidatesLead: Use the link from your invite. Before test day you can practise coding problems, try mock tests and earn certificates on your own free account.
candidatesPoint1: Run your code against sample tests before you submit
candidatesPoint2: Your answers save as you go
ctaTitle: Run your next screening on CodeSpectra.
ctaLead: Start with a pilot on one open role. We set up the assessment with you and you see the ranked shortlist before you commit.
bentoAssessBody: Objective, coding, written and upload questions in one test. Checkable answers are scored automatically; open answers are scored by AI against your rubric.
bentoInterviewBody: Practise a technical or HR round by voice or text. You get a readiness verdict, a score for each skill and the gaps to work on.
bentoProctorBody: Face checks, full-screen and tab tracking, paste blocking and code-similarity reports, rolled into one trust score per attempt.
bentoCompanyBody: Practise the sections, timings and question mix of real hiring tests, at easy, moderate and tough levels.
bentoContestBody: Capture the flag, code golf, debug-a-thons, datathons, system design jams and more, with live standings.
bentoPassportBody: Every result adds evidence to a shareable record of your skill levels that anyone can verify.
bentoCampusBody: Colleges run placement drives with eligibility rules, readiness tracking and offer records. Students apply in one place.
bentoMentorsBody: Book verified mentors for mock interviews, code reviews, resume reviews and career guidance.
bentoWhatsappBody: A daily question in your chat, graded when you reply, plus a short weekly mock. Your streak carries over to the app.
bentoWhatsappCorrect: Correct! Your streak is now 6 days.
bentoLangBody: The site, test instructions and your dashboard in the language you read best.
bentoCtaBody: Practise as a learner, or book a pilot and screen your next batch of candidates.
